Game loop calls initalization broadcast at starts and wait until all sprites initialize its data.

Then it enters forever loop where multiply scripts are called:

OldTime and DeltaTime calculates time between frames, so when you increase some number
by delta time each frame, that number will increase exactly 1 each second , you ,multiply that
increasing by constant to achieve constant growth of that variable per second.

The broadcasts which are called every frame are Update and Draw/

In Update we update game logic like moving, collision etc/
In Draw we draw all our objects like player ,enemies, bullets.
